useCases.title: SOC 2 CC7.1 — System-operations monitoring: uptime attestation and alert-noise governance
useCases.value: Lets the Head of IT Operations present the Audit Committee with coverage % (target 100% for production) and alert-noise % (target <5/day/CI). The same query replaces three spreadsheets.

useCases.title: Termination — Access Revocation Within Policy Window

useCases.title: PCI-DSS 2.2 — Secure configuration baseline: drift from approved hardening template

useCases.title: PCI-DSS 8.3 — Strong authentication: password-only logins against privileged accounts
useCases.value: Catches the exact condition that has historically resulted in CDE breaches (privileged password-only sessions). MTTR shrinks from weeks to minutes.

useCases.title: PCI-DSS 8.4 — MFA coverage: administrative access to CDE without MFA
useCases.value: The #1 QSA finding in failed assessments. Converting this to a 10-minute detection reduces remediation cost 100×.

useCases.title: PCI-DSS 8.6 — Application and system accounts: interactive use of a service account

useCases.title: PCI-DSS 10.4 — Time synchronisation: NTP drift on CDE hosts

useCases.title: PCI-DSS 10.7 — Log retention: CDE data-source retention + immutability attestation
useCases.value: Prevents the audit-killing discovery that retention was silently reduced during an index rebuild. Daily attestation beats the quarterly spot-check.

useCases.value: Closes the #1 open-finding reason at QSAs — 'the scan history was incomplete'. Continuous measurement is the intended replacement.
